## Size projection

A scenario unit is one motif in one of the three matched interaction structures. A condition row is one scenario unit under one framing/paraphrase condition, before multiplying by target models, seeds, or replicates.

| Scope | Motifs | Scenario units (×3 structures) | Main-v3 rows (×5 frames) | Full paraphrase rows (×17 variants) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Frozen main | 51 | 153 | 765 | 2601 |
| Entire candidate pool | 51 | 153 | 765 | 2601 |

The 17-condition robustness set is nested inside the same five frame families: one neutral condition and four paraphrases for each of the four non-neutral families. It is not a 17-frame taxonomy.

## Coverage judgment

The frozen main benchmark includes the entire eligible 51-motif pool across all 24 categories. Its largest concentrations are `climate_and_disaster` (7), `health_and_biomedicine` (7), `governance_and_control` (6), `elections_and_information` (5). These concentrations should be treated as an explicit design choice, not as a reason to use motif-family clustering, not to discard eligible narratives.

Further expansion is paused by this rule:

> Do not add another candidate solely to increase N. Add one only if a single eligible anchor documents a complete conspiracy narrative with a reasoning mechanism or substantive domain not already represented in the 51-item pool.

The selection boundary is frozen. The next dataset-content action is to author exactly three matched interaction structures per motif, staying within each complete-story anchor and authoring boundary.
